scope: The standing Guangdong Museum exterior in Zhujiang New Town, including the elevated carved-box shell, west entrance and recessed roof court.

originalReview.notes: The exact cleared original shows the southern and western cladding patterns, deep red returns, raised box, and recessed atrium roof with raised rectangular skylight.

quallaSearch.notes: Started with the exactly matched Qualla CC0 exterior. Architecture records supplied building dimensions and materials.
